newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values continues to rise.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values continues to rise.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values continued to rise, with nearby offers up six cents per bushel from Monday, in reaction to exporters needing corn to cover sales to Spain, grain dealers said.
Last week the European Union reduced import levies on 32,000 tonnes of U.S. corn to Spain.
Soybean and winter wheat basis values were mostly unchanged and the markets were quiet. Mexico was scheduled to tender overnight for 29,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for April shipment.
